_comment: Future / later scope: turning the embedded library (see progress.json) into a standalone, multi-tenant SaaS service. Build only when there's a concrete reason (productize/sell as hosted, frontend-direct read path, or independent scaling). The embedded library is the foundation; everything here is additive behind the same Hub interface.

issues.name: Standalone server — topology A: frontend -> api-server -> searchkit (HTTP)
tasks: === GOAL ===

[ ] Run searchkit as a separate service the api-server calls over HTTP for ranked ids; the api-server still hydrates ids -> cards from its own DB. Adds one server-to-server hop (in-datacenter, small).
=== WHEN ===
[ ] Worth it for: polyglot/multiple consumer apps, or scaling vector/embedding compute independently of the api-server. NOT needed if a single Go api-server embeds searchkit.
=== WORK ===
[ ] HTTP server exposing each `Hub` method; thin pass-through to the core (no business logic in transport).
[ ] Service-to-service auth (api-server -> searchkit).
[ ] Still id-returning; api-server hydrates. No render payloads required for this topology.

issues.name: Standalone server — topology B: frontend -> searchkit (frontend-direct, openrails-style)
tasks: === GOAL ===

[ ] searchkit answers the frontend DIRECTLY with full card responses (e.g. front page -> popular videos with thumbnails + links; search -> matching galleries). Removes the api-server from the read path (can be CDN/cache-friendly).
=== REQUIRES (the real cost) ===

[ ] Render payloads (see issue): searchkit must store + echo each entity's presentation data (thumbnail URL, click-through link, title, duration/pages, ...). This DUPLICATES a slice of the app's content model and needs cache invalidation on change.
[ ] Hub-side gating via generic facets (see issue): the app server isn't in the loop, so FilterSQL-against-app-tables can't gate — premium/age/region must be enforced from pushed facets.
[ ] Auth: the frontend's authkit token carries subject + tenant; searchkit gates on token + facets.
=== WHEN ===
[ ] Worth it to offload the api-server for read-heavy pages, or as a hosted product. Trades data duplication for a removed hop.

issues.name: Push ingestion (UpsertEntity) — replace pull-callbacks (standalone-only need)
tasks: === GOAL ===

[ ] Move content ingestion from host pull-callbacks (BuildLexicalString/BuildSemanticDocument/ListAssetURLs) to host PUSH (`UpsertEntity`). Embedded can keep pull-callbacks; a standalone server CAN'T call back into the host's Go funcs, so push is what makes server mode work.
=== WORK ===
[ ] `UpsertEntity(ctx, EntityDoc{lexical, semantic, asset_urls, visible_from, deleted, flags, attrs, num_attrs, render?})` — write entity registry + search document + mark `search_dirty`.
[ ] `DeleteEntity(ctx, EntityRef)` — tombstone + clean artifacts.
[ ] Worker (`SyncOnce`) fed by pushes; remove pull-callback contract from the supported surface.
[ ] `UpsertEntity` drives lexical + embedding indexing end-to-end with a fake embedder (test).

issues.name: Generic-facet gating (hub-side filtering, no host in the loop)
tasks: === GOAL ===

[ ] Let searchkit gate results by itself (for frontend-direct), using host-defined facets it stores but assigns no meaning to. Embedded gates via the host's own tables (FilterSQL / EntityCatalog reading host tables); this issue is for when the host isn't in the loop.
=== WORK ===
[ ] Entity facets: `flags` (set-membership: premium/r18/region), `attrs` (key/value), `num_attrs` (numeric) + universal `visible_from`/`deleted`; pushed via `UpsertEntity`.
[ ] Mirror facets into the signal store so unseen/popular/search gate without cross-store joins.
[ ] Query filter compiles host facet predicate into the retrieval/anti-join queries (pre-pagination).
[ ] Reminder: facets are a denormalized copy -> re-push on premium/visibility change.

issues.name: Render payloads (frontend-direct card responses)
tasks: === GOAL ===

[ ] Optional opaque `render` blob per entity (thumbnail URL, click-through link, title, duration/pages, badges) pushed on `UpsertEntity` and echoed verbatim in result hits — so searchkit can return ready-to-render cards to the frontend. The hub assigns no meaning to it (mechanism vs meaning).
=== WORK ===
[ ] Add optional `Render` field to `EntityDoc`; store it; include it on `Hit` when requested.
[ ] Cache-invalidation: re-push `render` when presentation data changes; document staleness window.
[ ] Embedded mode ignores it (host hydrates ids locally -> no duplication).

issues.name: Multi-tenancy (many tenants across apps; SaaS)
tasks: === GOAL ===
[ ] One hosted searchkit serving multiple apps (e.g. doujins + hentai0) as isolated tenants. Embedded stays single-tenant; this is the hosted/SaaS path. Modeled on authkit TenantSlug/TenantsEnabled.
=== WORK ===
[ ] `tenant_id` enforced on every read/write in the core (no raw unscoped queries); resolve tenant from the authkit token claim (server).
[ ] Per-tenant isolation of entities/signals/search/recs (no cross-tenant leakage); isolation mechanism = uniform `tenant_id` column (PG + CH).
[ ] Two-tenant conformance fixture: search/history/recs never cross tenants.
[ ] Note: even embedded keeps a `tenant_id` column (one value) so embedded and multi-tenant share code.

issues.name: Remote client SDK + cross-mode conformance
tasks: === GOAL ===
[ ] A remote client SDK implementing the SAME `Hub` interface over HTTP (`NewRemote(url)`), so host code is identical whether searchkit is embedded or remote.
=== WORK ===
[ ] `NewRemote(url, RemoteConfig{TokenSource})` returns `Hub`; marshals the same request/response types.
[ ] One conformance suite runs against both the embedded core and the remote client.
[ ] (optional) gRPC transport alongside HTTP.
